title_sq: Disponojme ambient per zyra per qira me vendodhje ne Bllok.
description_sq:
Disponojme ambient per zyra per qira me vendodhje ne Bllok.
Informacion mbi ambientin:
• Kati 1
• Sipërfaqe neto 760 m2
• Sipërfaqe bruto 780 m2
• Kubaturë e rregullt
• Mundesi ndarje dhe organizimi sipas tipologjise
• Ndertim i ri, me ashensor
• Ambienti jepet bosh
• Tualet per meshkuj e femra, plotesisht funksionale e te arreduara.
• Dy ambjente me instalime te gatshme per kuzhina (opsionale, mund te perdoren si zyra)
• Dhoma teknike e panelit elektrik kryesor me automate
• Dhoma kryesore e serverave dhe sistemeve.
• Dhoma e kasafortes se thesarit e dizenjuar nga italianet ne funksion te bankes Veneto si rezidente e meparshme.
• Dy dalje emergjence
• Parket
• Sistem ngrohje/ftohje dhe filtrim I ajrit, i cili do te vendoset sipas kerkesave te qeramarresit
• Ndricimi LED, ekonomik, I fuqishem dhe eficent
• Sistem kamerash dhe sigurie
• Shkalle elektrike levizese
• Fasade xhami, qe mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites
• E pershtatshme per tipologji te ndryshme zyrash dhe bizneseh si: klinike, call center, estetike etj
• Lirohet ne fund te muajit dhjetor
• Ne cmim eshte i perfshire edhe tatimi mbi burim
title_en: We have office space for rent located in Block.
description_en: We have office space for rent located in Block. Information about the environment: • 1st floor • Net area 760 m2 • Gross area 780 m2 • Regular cubature • Possibility of division and organization according to typology • New building, with elevator • The environment is given empty • Toilets for men and women, fully functional and furnished. • Two rooms with ready installations for kitchens (optional, can be used as offices) • Technical room of the main electrical panel with machines • Main room of servers and systems. • The treasure vault room designed by the Italians in function of the Veneto bank as a previous resident. • Two emergency exits • Parquet • Heating/cooling and air filtration system, which will be installed according to the tenant's requirements • LED lighting, economical, powerful and efficient • Camera and security system • Electric escalator • Glass facade, which allows natural lighting throughout the day • Suitable for different typologies of offices and businesses such as: clinics, call centers, aesthetics, etc. • Available at the end of December • The price includes the withholding tax
